# Life Ledger · Deep Review 2.1.0 · Mac 3.1.0

Web **2.1.0** ships **bookkeeping** (Money / 记账 / Finanzen): quick entry, budgets, German CSV import/export, Today **Spending today**, and monthly Review spending with mood/habit/focus insights.

Mac app **3.1.0** bundles the same web assets.

## Highlights since the feature freeze

- **Cross-page spend context:** Today compares spend **vs yesterday**; Week insights add **week spending** (opens Money) with a same-days-last-week hint; Review spending compares **vs last month** on aligned calendar days.
- **Habit & journal context on Week:** completion rate and focus-time tiles caption **vs last week** (percentage points and journal/event days).
- **Recurring fixes:** weekly templates stay due per ISO week; pills and banners count **unposted occurrences**, not template rows only.
